sources.label: Sailor Piece Wiki - islands route notes

items.name: Starter Island
items.keyContent: Starter quests, first weapon pickup, tutorial route, hidden puzzle progress
items.progressionUse: Begin here, learn the basics, then move toward Jungle and Desert.

items.name: Sailor Island
items.keyContent: Fruit Dealers, merchants, rerolls, ascension, Boss Rush, Jinwoo and Alucard routes
items.progressionUse: Return here often because services and repeat routes stay useful past early game.

items.name: Jungle Island
items.keyContent: Jungle quests, early enemy farming, hidden collection spots
items.progressionUse: Use it after starter routes before Desert and Snow open up.

items.name: Desert Island
items.keyContent: Observation Haki Master, desert quests, hidden puzzle piece
items.progressionUse: Visit when you are ready to start Haki progress and push toward dungeon setup.

items.name: Dungeon Island
items.keyContent: Dungeon Master, Shadow route, Shadow Monarch route, dungeon unlock chain
items.progressionUse: Unlock the island early, then return at 5000+ when dungeon access matters.

items.name: Snow Island
items.keyContent: Armament Haki, artifacts, upgrade station, Skill Tree, Hogyoku Fragment progress
items.progressionUse: Treat it as a major account-power stop, not just another leveling island.

items.name: Christmas Island
items.keyContent: Ragna boss, Christmas event rewards, limited seasonal drops
items.progressionUse: Check it during event windows, even if your normal route is somewhere else.

items.name: World Island
items.keyContent: Sea Traveler, Ancient Fragments, Map Pieces, Cartographer handoff
items.progressionUse: Use it late in the first sea when you are working toward the Sea 2 route.

items.name: Boss Island
items.bosses: Saber, Ichigo, Gilgamesh, Qin Shi, Blessed Maiden
items.keyContent: Boss Summoner, Boss Exchange, boss keys, fighting-style and weapon routes
items.progressionUse: Go here for summon routes and unlock materials instead of normal mob farming.

items.name: Shibuya Station
items.keyContent: Yuji, Gojo, Sukuna, Conqueror Haki, accessory enchanting, puzzle and fragment progress
items.progressionUse: Use it when boss drops, Haki progress, trainers, and enchants start overlapping.

items.name: Hueco Mundo
items.keyContent: Aizen boss, specialized trainers, Hogyoku Fragment progress, late material farming
items.progressionUse: Move here when the mid-game route turns into Aizen, fragments, and stronger unlocks.

items.name: Shinjuku Island
items.bosses: Strongest of Today, Strongest in History
items.keyContent: Strongest bosses, mastery progress, Hogyoku Fragment progress, dense enemy farming
items.progressionUse: Use it as an early endgame combat and boss route before higher islands open.

items.name: Slime Island
items.keyContent: Rimuru boss, Skill Tree NPC, Slime puzzle, Hogyoku Fragment progress
items.progressionUse: Visit when stat scaling, puzzle progress, and the Rimuru route become useful.

items.name: Tower Island
items.keyContent: Infinite Tower access and endgame progression activity
items.progressionUse: Use it when you are ready for tower-style progression instead of island farming.

items.name: Soul Society
items.keyContent: True Aizen, Hogyoku Quest requirement, Transcendent Being title route
items.progressionUse: Go here after the Hogyoku route is ready, not just because your level is high enough.

items.name: Academy Island
items.keyContent: Anos boss, Anos fighting style NPC, high-level training facility
items.progressionUse: Use it as a high-level boss and fighting-style stop after earlier endgame routes.

items.name: JoJo Island
items.keyContent: The World boss, The World melee spec, Time Tyrant title route
items.progressionUse: Visit for the DIO-inspired route and Sea 2-style endgame progression.

items.name: Judgement Island
items.keyContent: Yamato boss, Yamato sword, Yamato fighting style materials, Hogyoku Fragment progress
items.progressionUse: Use it when your endgame route needs Yamato drops or fighting-style materials.

items.name: Valentine Island
items.keyContent: Madoka boss, Valentine event route, high-HP seasonal encounter
items.progressionUse: Check it for event-linked endgame farming and Madoka boss progress.

items.name: Lawless Island
items.keyContent: Atomic Boss, Atomic melee spec Seller, Arena Fighters, Abyss Sigils
items.progressionUse: Use it when your build route points toward Atomic unlocks and Abyss Sigils.

items.name: Ninja Island
items.keyContent: Strongest Shinobi boss, Strongest Shinobi seller, Battlefield Warlord title
items.progressionUse: Farm it for the late Shinobi route and title-gated unlock progress.
